counterhypotheses.claim: LLM-facing multimodal projector outputs are optimized to condition generation, not to make cosine/prototype distances calibrated for instance identity or OOD rejection. A stable spatial pyramid cannot repair a fundamentally unsuitable metric geometry.
support: Qwen's dedicated Qwen3-VL-Embedding line uses separate retrieval-oriented training and final semantic-vector extraction rather than claiming raw generative visual features are retrieval embeddings.
Existing QNDRF-1 already preserved this concern; this run strengthens the test by splitting projected vs pre-merger Qwen feature strata.

counterhypotheses.claim: Spatial merge/projection may erase fine UI/text/layout cues that survive in Qwen3.5 pre-merger vision hidden states; public mtmd output may therefore be convenient but causally inferior for familiarity.
A tiny specialized image encoder can be so cheap that duplicate encoding is rational if it enables large reductions in 4B semantic-decode frequency and false-familiarity risk.

llama.cpp media/slot state is an implementation-local acceleration surface with experimental API churn and version coupling. Treating it as durable Frank state would create a brittle hidden architecture and recovery burden.
counterhypotheses.architectural_consequence: Keep server/media cache optional and rebuildable; semantic truth remains typed Clay state plus provenance-bound observations/descriptors.

counterhypotheses.claim: Absolute/coarse token-grid topology may overfit window position and fail under harmless resize/move/theme changes. A descriptor that wins same-layout accuracy but loses transformation robustness is not a valid Frank familiarity improvement.
